# Install `full-width-toggle` — Full Width Toggle

> Page-container width toggle (contained / wide / full).

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/full-width-toggle
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=full-width-toggle
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/full-width-toggle

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add full-width-toggle
# alias: npx rr add full-width-toggle
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `layout`, `preference`, `localstorage`, `dashboard`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add full-width-toggle`. Drop <WidthContainer> around page content, <FullWidthToggle variant='icon' /> in topbar. Variant 'segment' best for settings page. Hook useFullWidth() returns [mode, setMode, cycle]. SSR-safe — defaults to 'contained' until hydrate.
